const cmd=String.raw`$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = (Get-Location).Path
$setup = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'evidence/hg11-approve2/setup.json' | ConvertFrom-Json
$paths = @(
  'docs/overview.md', 'docs/ARCHITECTURE.md', 'docs/ENGINEERING.md',
  'docs/DEVELOPMENT.md', 'docs/deployment-guide.md',
  'counter.py', 'test_counter.py', 'README.md', 'AGENTS.md',
  '.highgrade/project/INSTRUCTIONS.md', 'specs/catalog.json',
  '.pilot-profile/.highgrade/global/active.json',
  '.pilot-profile/.highgrade/global/releases/v0-2-14/highgrade.exe',
  'evidence/hg11-approve2/scope-extension.json'
)
$hashes = [ordered]@{}
foreach ($path in $paths) {
  $file = Join-Path $root ($path.Replace('/', '\'))
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Missing dependency: $path" }
  $hashes[$path] = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $file).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
}
$head = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git rev-parse failed' }
$manifest = [ordered]@{
  captured_at = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  root = $root
  accepted_path = 'docs/overview.md'
  before_head = $setup.before_head
  work_head = $head
  before_sha256 = $setup.before_sha256
  work_sha256 = $hashes
  checks = [ordered]@{
    global_status = 'evidence/hg11-approve2/global-status.json'
    doctor = 'evidence/hg11-approve2/doctor.json'
    link_check = 'evidence/hg11-approve2/link-check-final.txt'
    documented_command = 'python -B -m unittest discover -v'
    unittest_exit_code = 0
    unittest_raw = 'evidence/hg11-approve2/unittest-verbose.txt'
    diff_check_exit_code = 0
    diff = 'evidence/hg11-approve2/work-final.diff'
  }
}
$json = $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root 'evidence/hg11-approve2/work-snapshot.json'), $json + [Environment]::NewLine, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Output "work_head=$head"
Write-Output "overview_sha256=$($hashes['docs/overview.md'])"
Write-Output "development_sha256=$($hashes['docs/DEVELOPMENT.md'])"
Write-Output "test_counter_sha256=$($hashes['test_counter.py'])"`;

const cmd=String.raw`$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = (Get-Location).Path
$work = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'evidence/hg11-approve2/work-snapshot.json' | ConvertFrom-Json
$work.work_sha256.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object {
  $path = $_.Name
  $expected = $_.Value
  $actual = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root ($path.Replace('/', '\')))).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw "Dependency changed since work: $path" }
}
git diff --quiet -- docs/overview.md
$unstagedTargetExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($unstagedTargetExit -ne 0) { throw 'Accepted file has unstaged changes' }
$stagedPaths = @(git diff --cached --name-only)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $stagedPaths.Count -ne 1 -or $stagedPaths[0] -ne 'docs/overview.md') { throw 'Staged path set changed' }
$head = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $head -ne $work.work_head) { throw 'HEAD changed since work' }
$blob = (git rev-parse ':docs/overview.md').Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not read staged blob' }
git status --porcelain=v1 > 'evidence/hg11-approve2/precommit-status.txt'
$manifest = [ordered]@{
  checked_at = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  head = $head
  accepted_path = 'docs/overview.md'
  work_snapshot = 'evidence/hg11-approve2/work-snapshot.json'
  work_inputs_unchanged = $true
  staged_paths = $stagedPaths
  staged_blob = $blob
  staged_diff = 'evidence/hg11-approve2/staged.diff'
  staged_diff_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath 'evidence/hg11-approve2/staged.diff').Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  staged_diff_check_exit = 0
  accepted_file_unstaged_diff_exit = $unstagedTargetExit
  test_reused = 'evidence/hg11-approve2/unittest-verbose.txt'
  test_reason_not_repeated = 'Состав проверенного документа и значимых зависимостей не изменился после work.'
}
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root 'evidence/hg11-approve2/approve-precommit.json'), ($manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6) + [Environment]::NewLine, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Output "head=$head staged=$($stagedPaths -join ',') blob=$blob inputs_unchanged=True"`;
